sentence: She hopes to become close to some of the club members this year.
synonym: make friends with some of the club members
synonymNote: 两者都表示与俱乐部成员建立友好关系

distractors.word: leave some of the club members
distractors.note: 意思相反，表示离开而非亲近

distractors.word: argue with some of the club members
distractors.note: 表示争吵，与建立亲密关系意思不同

distractors.word: forget some of the club members
distractors.note: 表示忘记，不是建立关系的意思
